test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How does most of India's foreign trade take place?

options.text: Equally through land, air and sea routes each

solution:
The correct answer is __**Through sea and air routes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India is surrounded by water on three sides and has a coastline of 7516.6 km.
 
• This geographical feature has made sea transport the major player in carrying out the international trade of India.
 
• Most of India’s foreign trade is carried through sea and air routes.
